## The skill

<!-- Who reaches for this, and at what moment? One or two sentences. -->

## Kind

- [ ] Tool-agnostic (role verbs, no product names)
- [ ] Tool-specific (every product listed in `tools:`)

## Before requesting review

- [ ] `node tools/validate.mjs` is clean
- [ ] Changes are confined to `skills/<my-slug>/`
- [ ] First PR only: `author.md` is included with my own LinkedIn profile, a headline, and expertise keywords
- [ ] `## What good looks like` says what I notice first, what the mediocre version does, and how I judge the output
- [ ] Depth (numbers, scripts, worked examples) lives in `references/`
- [ ] Nothing in these files sends data anywhere the reader doesn't own, embeds a secret, overrides agent instructions, or runs a bulk/destructive step without confirmation
- [ ] I'm publishing this under MIT with my name attached
